-- DISTRIBUTION Type
--  1) Hash Key 
--  1) ROUND_ROBIN
--  3) Replicate

create table dbo.VS
(
    STUDYID varchar(100),
    DOMAIN varchar(100),
    USUBJID varchar(100),
    VSSEQ varchar(100),
    VSTESTCD varchar(100),
    VSTEST varchar(100),
    VSORRES varchar(100),
    VSORRESU varchar(100),
    VISITNUM varchar(100),
    VISIT varchar(100),
    VSDTC varchar(100),
    MoDIFIED_TS  varchar(100)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH (STUDYID)
);
select * from dbo.VS
select COUNT(*) from dbo.VS

COPY INTO [dbo].[vs] FROM 'https://stsynapseclintrial.blob.core.windows.net/landing/VS.csv'
WITH (
   FIELDTERMINATOR=',',
   ROWTERMINATOR='0x0A'
) OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.VS');
